name: Trattoria Pizzeria da Rocco
kurzbeschreibung:
**Trattoria Pizzeria da Rocco in Weer** is a cozy Italian restaurant nestled in the heart of the **Zillertal** valley, just a short drive from **Innsbruck**. This charming spot offers authentic **Pizza Napoletana**, handmade pasta, and a selection of classic Italian dishes, all prepared with fresh, local ingredients.

The rustic atmosphere, combined with warm hospitality, makes it a perfect place to unwind after a day of exploring **Tirol**’s stunning landscapes. Whether you’re craving a crispy **Pizza Margherita** or a hearty **Spaghetti Bolognese**, **Trattoria Pizzeria da Rocco** delivers delicious flavors in a relaxed setting.

Don’t miss their homemade desserts—like **Tiramisu** or **Cannoli**—for the perfect sweet finish to your meal. A must-visit for food lovers and travelers alike!
